verdict.rationale: Raygun documents a Crash Reporting export that can export all or selected error groups from the dashboard (raygun-docs-9), and its changelog confirms CSV exports, an open format, for filtered views such as Most Requested Pages, Tags and Country codes (raygun-docs-18, raygun-docs-35). This covers error-group data and some views, not a complete account export, so it delivers only part of the story. Missing for 10: evidence of a full-account export covering RUM/APM and all product data, the file format of the crash-reporting export, an account deletion or offboarding path, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
